description: Search the BBB business directory (US and Canada) by keyword and location, with rating, accreditation, sort and detail options.

includeBranchLocations.description: BBB lists some businesses once per location (branches, franchises, service addresses). Off: one record per business. On: one record per listed location, each with its own address, phone and coordinates.
includeBranchLocations.title: Include branch locations

includeDetails.description: Also open each business's BBB profile for website, emails, contacts, dates, hours, licences, social links, reviews and complaints. Turn off for faster runs with search-listing data only.
includeDetails.title: Include profile details

keywords.description: What to search for on BBB: a business category (plumber, electrician, roofing, auto repair) or a company name. Required unless startUrls is set.
keywords.title: Keywords

locations.description: Optional cities or postal codes, e.g. 'Chicago, IL', '10001', 'Toronto, ON'. Each is searched separately; businesses found twice are returned once. Leave empty for a country-wide search.
locations.title: Locations

maxRecordsGlobal.description: Maximum number of businesses for the whole run, across all locations.
maxRecordsGlobal.title: Max businesses (total)

maxRecordsPerLocation.description: Maximum per location (0 = no per-location limit). BBB shows up to 225 businesses per search, so use several locations for more.
maxRecordsPerLocation.title: Max businesses per location

minRating.description: Only businesses rated at least this grade (businesses without a rating are excluded when set).
minRating.title: Minimum BBB rating

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. BBB is fetched directly first; Apify proxies are used automatically only if needed. Choose your own proxy to use it as the fallback, or 'No proxy' to stay direct.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

startUrls.description: BBB search or business-profile URLs to scrape instead of a keyword search. Search URLs keep the keyword, location, country, accreditation, sort and state parameters they contain, and every result page is followed. Profile URLs return one fully detailed business each. When this is set, Keywords, Locations, Country, Sort and State are ignored.
startUrls.title: Start URLs (optional)

stateFilter.description: Optional two-letter state or province code (e.g. IL, ON) to keep results from one state when a search area spans several.
stateFilter.title: State / province filter

title: Better Business Bureau (BBB) Scraper
